Correct System Outcome: Create child Work Order as Finished Job
Required Fields from FM: Reason + Scope to complete + Parent WO + Lot
Required Photos: Yes — at least 1 proof photo of incomplete area
Notes: Use WO parent-child. Fields: Is_Finish_Job__c, Finish_Job_Reason__c, Finish_Job_Notes__c

Correct System Outcome: Create Warranty_Record__c and route to Customer Success
Secondary Objects Created: Case (type: Warranty) if CS-facing communication needed
Required Fields from FM: Category + Original WO + Date original work completed + Issue description + Severity
Required Photos: Yes — required for all warranty types
Notes: Use Warranty_Record__c.WorkOrder__c + Case__c. Category options: Plant warranty / Sod / Irrigation / Drainage / Hardscape / Settlement / Washout / Cleanup / Damage / Builder punch / Homeowner complaint

Blocks Closeout?: NO — unless complaint relates to scope
Notes: Route to Customer Care queue. May also trigger Warranty_Record__c if physical issue.

Required Fields from FM: Builder Account + Community + Lot + WO + Scope + Billable recommendation
Blocks Closeout?: MAYBE — depends on whether LOVING owes the item

Secondary Objects Created: Change_Order__c if associated with active WO
Required Fields from FM: Account + Lot + WO + Scope description + Quantities + FM notes
Required Photos: Recommended — required if drainage or structural
Blocks Closeout?: NO — scope request is additive; does not block current job
Notes: FM cannot set price. CS owns pricing and routing to Estimating.

Required Fields from FM: WO + Lot + PO Qty vs. Measured Qty + Reason for variance
Required Photos: Recommended — photo of actual vs. expected
Blocks Closeout?: MAYBE — if variance blocks scope completion
Notes: FM-measured quantities must be entered before submitting. Cross-reference Takeoff_*__c fields on WO.

Correct System Outcome: Create Schedule_Issue__c; create UMB_Quote_Request__c if billable scope change needed
Owner / Queue: Scheduling Manager + Customer Success if billable
Required Fields from FM: Summary + Severity + Billable flag + Location description
Notification Triggered: Task to Scheduling Manager; Task to CS if billable
Notes: Severity: High if standing water on install date. Trigger quote request only if fix is out of original scope.

Correct System Outcome: Create Schedule_Issue__c (type: Utility Conflict) + update 811 status
Secondary Objects Created: UMB_Quote_Request__c if scope change; Task to Safety if active hazard
Required Fields from FM: Location + 811 status + utility type + access constraint
Notification Triggered: Task to Scheduling Manager; escalate to Safety Officer if active hazard
Notes: Use Schedule_Issue__c.Standard_Work_Order__c + Service_Appointment__c. Set Severity=High. Update WO.Site_Ready__c=false.

Required Fields from FM: Reason + Blocker type + Requested reschedule date
Notes: Use WO fields: Site_Not_Ready_Reason__c, Site_Readiness_Notes__c, Site_Ready__c=false, Site_Readiness_Status__c

Correct System Outcome: Create Schedule_Issue__c (type: Crew Damage) + escalate to Regional Manager
Required Fields from FM: Description + Location + Crew ID + Damage extent
Notification Triggered: Task to Regional Manager; alert FM
Blocks Closeout?: MAYBE — if damage is on install surface
Notes: Do not involve customer directly. Internal investigation first. If customer property damaged: add Case after manager review.

Correct System Outcome: Create Schedule_Issue__c (type: Material Issue) + notify Inventory
Required Fields from FM: Material name + Qty needed + WO + Lot
Notification Triggered: Task to Inventory and Scheduling Manager
Blocks Closeout?: MAYBE — if material is required for scope completion
Notes: If material can be same-day sourced: Severity=Medium. If blocks install: update WO Site_Ready__c=false and set Severity=High.

Secondary Objects Created: Task to Safety Officer + Regional Manager
Notification Triggered: Escalation: Safety Officer + Regional Manager mandatory
Blocks Closeout?: YES — halt all work until cleared
Notes: Severity=High always. Do not allow FM to continue without acknowledgment from manager. No customer communication until manager review.

Correct System Outcome: Update WorkOrder + create Schedule_Issue__c (type: Access) + notify Scheduling
Secondary Objects Created: Task to Scheduling Manager; contact builder/homeowner if needed
Required Fields from FM: Access type + Builder contact if applicable + Lot
Notes: WO fields: Site_Not_Ready_Reason__c='Access', Site_Ready__c=false. Schedule_Issue__c for Scheduling Manager to reschedule.

Correct System Outcome: Create Schedule_Issue__c (type: Other) + require FM notes
Secondary Objects Created: Task to FM's manager for classification
Notes: FM notes are required. If Other is used too frequently: audit and add missing types to the router picklist.
